title: sign(): signed_data_version comment will mislead multi-signer extensions
description: sign.rs line 91-93: comment says 'RFC 5652 §5.1: SignedData.version is V3 if any SignerInfo uses SKI, else V1' but then sets signed_data_version = signer_info_version. This is coincidentally correct for one signer, but any contributor adding multi-signer support would implement this as 'iterate all signers, use V3 if any uses SKI'. The code needs either a comment explaining the single-signer assumption or a proper implementation.
